newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-BOLDON WINS FIRST MAJOR TITLE WITH BRILLIANT RUN.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BOLDON WINS FIRST MAJOR TITLE WITH BRILLIANT RUN.

text.p: Trinidad's Ato Boldon sealed the first world title of his career on Friday when he destroyed a high-class men's 200 metres field.

Boldon, who was disappointed at finishing fifth in the 100 metres after complaining of muscle problems in his legs, came off the bend in front and stretched his lead over the last 100 metres to win by some five metres.
The Olympic bronze medallist could afford the luxury of raising his arms up in triumph as he crossed the line in 20.04 seconds.
Namibia's former world champion Frankie Fredericks, who finished second at the last championships in 1995, took the silver again in 20.23 with Brazilian Claudinei Da Silva third in 20.26.
